title: Vertex Operator Algebra Realizations of Twisted Haagerup–Izumi Doubles
summary: We construct vertex operator algebras realizing an infinite family of twisted, nonunitary Haagerup--Izumi doubles. For every odd integer $N\geq 3$, we construct a spherical fusion category $\mathcal{F}_N$ with the Haagerup--Izumi fusion rules for $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ and pointed associator of exact order $N$, and realize its Drinfeld center as the ribbon category of modules of an explicit vertex operator algebra $\mathscr{V}_N$.
